devdoc.details: This contract manages the conversion process, including the initialization of reserves, adjusting ZKP reserves, and processing the conversion of PRP to zZKP.

convert(uint256[],((uint256,uint256),(ui.details: Handles the spending of old zAccount UTXOs and creates new ones with the updated PRP balance. The user can choose whether the UTXO should be added quickly via the taxi tree or slowly via the bus tree. The transactionOptions param defines the method used (further details can be found in the `TransactionOptions.sol` library)

params.inputs: The public input parameters to be passed to the verifier. (see `PrpConversionPublicSignals.sol`).
params.privateMessages: Private message containing zAccount utxo data.
params.transactionOptions: Options for the transaction, encoded as a 17-bit number.
params.zkpAmountOutMin: The minimum amount of zZKP tokens to receive from the conversion.

returns.firstUtxoBusQueuePos: Position in the UTXO bus queue for the first UTXO.

increaseZkpReserve().details: This function can be called only after the contract has been initialized. It checks the current balance of ZKP tokens and updates the reserves if there are additional tokens beyond the current reserve. It also increases the Vault’s allowance to allow it to transfer ZKP tokens from this contract during conversion operations.

initPool(uint256,uint256).details: This function can only be called by the contract owner. ZKP tokens must be transferred to this contract prior to initialization. It also increases the Vault’s allowance to allow it to transfer ZKP tokens from this contract during conversion operations.

params.prpVirtualAmount: The virtual amount of PRP to initialize.
params.zkpAmount: The amount of ZKP tokens required for the initialization.

devdoc.title: PrpConversion

convert(uint256[],((uint256,uint256),(ui.notice: Converts PRP tokens to zZKP tokens.

increaseZkpReserve().notice: Increases the ZKP reserve based on the available balance.

initPool(uint256,uint256).notice: Initializes the conversion pool with specified amounts of PRP and ZKP tokens.

userdoc.notice: Handles the conversion of PRPs to zZKP tokens.
